claims.text: This excerpt shows a series of events related to client connections to a ZooKeeper server, including the establishment of new sessions and the closure of existing ones.
The events indicate that multiple clients from different IP addresses are connecting to the server, with each connection being assigned a unique session ID and a negotiated timeout of 10000.
The excerpt also mentions a closed socket connection and an end of stream exception, indicating some disruption or error in the communication with one of the clients.
